cell_seed_rule: For each cell, take the first 16 hexadecimal digits of SHA-256 over UTF-8 '<seed>|<dataset_id>|<horizon_months>|<coverage>|<comparison>|<corrected_mean_config>|<cost_scenario>' as an unsigned base-16 integer; this makes cells order-independent.

cells.block_construction: Within one dataset-horizon cell, sort the N included episode estimands by nominal start. For each replicate, draw circular block starts independently and uniformly from integers 0 through N-1, append L consecutive values modulo N for each draw, and truncate the final block so the resample contains exactly N values.
cells.p_value_finite_sample_rule: The unadjusted p-value is (1 + the centered two-sided tail count) / (B + 1).
cells.p_value_rule: For observed statistic T and replicate statistics T_b under null value zero, use the centered two-sided tail count abs(T_b-T) >= abs(T).
cells.quantile_rule: For probability p, sort the B uncentered replicate statistics and linearly interpolate at zero-based position (B-1)*p between its floor and ceiling indices.
cells.rng: CPython 3.12 random.Random using MT19937 and randrange(N) for each block-start draw

For each replicate, draw circular block starts independently and uniformly from integers 0 through N-1, append L consecutive values modulo N for each draw, and truncate the final block so the resample contains exactly N values.
cells.p_value_finite_sample_rule: The unadjusted p-value is (1 + the centered two-sided tail count) / (B + 1).
cells.p_value_rule: For observed statistic T and replicate statistics T_b under null value zero, use the centered two-sided tail count abs(T_b-T) >= abs(T).
cells.quantile_rule: For probability p, sort the B uncentered replicate statistics and linearly interpolate at zero-based position (B-1)*p between its floor and ceiling indices.
cells.rng: CPython 3.12 random.Random using MT19937 and randrange(N) for each block-start draw

holm_order: Sort by unadjusted p-value, then dataset_id, horizon_months, numeric coverage, comparison in H1-before-H2 order, corrected_mean_config, and cost_scenario; apply standard step-down Holm adjusted p-values with cumulative maxima capped at one.
